summary: Chapters 12 (Energy), 13 (EPA), 14 (Health and Human Services), 15 (Housing and Urban Development) and 16 (Interior) were read in full and matched against the existing records. 58 further recommendations were researched, independently reviewed and scored blind for significance: 12 in chapter 12, 12 in chapter 13, 11 in chapter 14, 11 in chapter 15 and 12 in chapter 16. By status: 1 blocked, 1 completed, 2 diverged, 12 implemented, 24 in progress, 6 not started, 12 proposed. One chapter 14 candidate was dropped in review as already covered by c14-09. Review changed the stage of 10 records, in most cases to a more cautious one. The counted set is now 373 recommendations. Candidates left behind the 12-per-chapter cap are listed in the work queue for the second pass. The chapter summaries for chapters 12 to 16 were rewritten to cover all of their records.
title: Fuller reading of chapters 12 to 16: 58 recommendations added
